name: AsteroidZ
summary: Fast-paced, top-down multiplayer space shooter set in a retro arena. Players pilot customizable ships with fluid, analog controls, battling to survive and dominate in a seamless, wrap-around world. The core loop involves destroying asteroids and enemy players to collect glowing pellets, which fuel a dynamic upgrade system that increases your ship's health, speed, and damage, causing you to visually grow in scale and power. With tactical abilities like deployable mines and a speed boost, the game blends classic arcade action with modern progression, creating a competitive, skill-based experience where constant growth and spatial awareness are key to victory.
